analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 57.7 to 61.2, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from 3.4279 to 8.0249, continuing bullish expansion. The 5-day low ($293.08) is higher than the 20-day low ($225.46), forming a Higher Low pattern. Although volume ratio is 0.79, indicating some contraction, the improving indicators maintain a bullish bias.
